title: Abelian subcategory criterion
statement: Let $\mathcal T$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], and let $\iota:\mathcal A\to\mathcal T$ be a fully faithful additive functor from an additive category $\mathcal A$ (a preadditive category with a zero object and finite biproducts). Suppose that $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal T}(\iota X,\iota Y[n])=0$ for all $X,Y\in\mathcal A$ and $n<0$. Suppose also that for every $f:X\to Y$ in $\mathcal A$ and every distinguished triangle $\iota X\xrightarrow{\iota f}\iota Y\to S\to\iota X[1]$, there are $K,Q\in\mathcal A$ and a distinguished triangle $\iota K[1]\to S\to\iota Q\to\iota K[2]$. Then $\mathcal A$ is abelian [def-sp-abelian].

source.place: Proposition 1.2.4, implication (ii) implies (i), with hypothesis 1.2.0 and Definition 1.2.3, pp. 27-28
